svg.text: RxJS: Observable, Subject, BehaviorSubject – Visual Guide
Angular · A09 · HTTP is a one-shot; current user remembers the last value
Promise is one future. Observable is a cancelable stream.
Header and guard must see the user after refresh.
switchMap cancels the old GET. Sequential waits do not.
Clicks are events. Auth state has a current value.
user$ for state. http.get for a search.
user$ = BehaviorSubject so late subscribers see now

text.tspan: Treat Observable as a Promise you cannot cancel
